runs.text: Some words are only special in one particular place. For example,
only means something inside a for-each loop, and
only as a method of a vector. Outside that position they are ordinary names. They are called
and do not reserve the name.

points.text: Reserved words make up the language and cannot be used as names.
Aliases are accepted and normalised to the main form.
Contextual words are only special in their position.
